title: 15th Annual Pershing Square Value Investing and Philanthropy Challenge
summary: The talk argues that PayPal is a high-quality compounder with a wide moat that has been unfairly punished, offering a significant buying opportunity with a specific price target for 2025. Conversely, the speaker views Carvana as a bankruptcy candidate due to high expenses and a desperate need to acquire a physical marketplace. The discussion also touches on Progeny's client base, noting that while Google and Meta are clients, the speaker does not express a specific investment view on those companies themselves.
